_about: Model catalog for the Models screen. Add an entry here to offer a new model. role: chat | gen | edit. engine: ollama (pulled into models/ by the private server) | mflux-flux2 (downloaded from Hugging Face and saved 8-bit into models/<dir>). mem_gb is the peak memory while it works.

models.name: Qwen3.5 9B abliterated
models.notes: Fast and light. Good interviews, sometimes misses details.
models.use_en: Fastest and lightest. For simple requests.

models.name: Qwen3.5 27B abliterated
models.notes: Recommended. Much smarter prompts, still fits next to normal work.
models.use_he: מומלץ. הכי חכם בהבנת הבקשה ובכתיבת הפרומפט.
models.use_en: Recommended. Best at understanding the request and writing the prompt.

models.name: Qwen3.5 35B-A3B abliterated (MoE)
models.notes: Very fast replies, more memory, a bit less precise than 27B.
models.use_he: תשובות מהירות מאוד, צורך יותר זיכרון.
models.use_en: Very fast replies, uses more memory.

models.name: Z-Image Turbo (fp8)
models.notes: Recommended default. Tested 2026-10-26: most natural people and age, 43 s per image. Weak at text inside the image.
models.use_he: מומלץ. אנשים ופנים מציאותיים, מהיר (כ-43 שנ').
models.use_en: Recommended. Realistic people and faces, fast (about 43 s).

models.name: FLUX.2 klein 4B (Ollama)
models.notes: Lighter and faster, a bit less realistic.

models.name: FLUX.2 klein 9B (Ollama)
models.use_he: פרטים וטקסט בתוך התמונה, בינוני בזיכרון.
models.use_en: Detail and text inside the image, medium memory.

models.name: FLUX.2 klein 9B (Ollama, fp8)
models.notes: Tested 2026-10-26: best for text inside the image (perfect plaque text). People look older and slightly less natural than Z-Image, 72 s per image vs 43 s. Non-commercial.
models.use_he: הכי טוב לטקסט בתוך התמונה (שלט, כרזה, לוגו). איטי יותר.
models.use_en: Best for text inside the image (sign, poster, logo). Slower.

models.name: FLUX.2 klein 4B (8-bit)
models.notes: Light. Face score about 0.90 when editing in place, about 0.5 in new scenes.
models.use_he: כשמצרפים תמונה: שמירת פנים, החלפת בגדים או רקע.
models.use_en: When you attach a photo: keep the face, change clothes or background.

_disabled._why: 2026-10-26: operator chose Ollama only - no Hugging Face login. Move an entry back into models to offer it again.

models.name: FLUX.2 klein 9B (8-bit)
models.notes: Recommended upgrade. Stronger identity and detail. Needs a Hugging Face login once.

models.name: FLUX.2 klein 9B KV (8-bit)
models.notes: 9B tuned for faster editing with reference photos.
